_comment: QuPath manual affine transforms. Each 2x3 matrix maps FROM the reference TO the source (QuPath's default direction when you drag the source onto the reference). Set invert=true (default when omitted) to reverse for forward warping into reference space. Reference for all samples: STOmics DAPI.
_usage: Paste two rows of 3 numbers from QuPath's affine transform output. The pipeline will auto-invert to get the forward (source→reference) direction.
